records.name: Bonanza Falls / Greenwood Falls
records.title: Parcel boundary conflict — visitor access unverified
records.summary: The Michigan GIS waterfall point lies in a parcel attributed to a private LLC, while a separate regional brochure point about 168 metres away lies in a township-attributed parcel. A signed local approach is described by tourism sources, but public parking rights and a lawful route to each riverbank have not been established.
records.guidance: Do not drive to the mapped waterfall point or infer a right to enter riverfront land. Use only clearly signed lawful access and check current local land-management guidance; no route or precise parking waypoint is supplied here.
records.locationNotes: Michigan GIS #124 (46.818863,-89.571458); regional Western U.P. brochure (46.817719,-89.570023); locations about 168 m apart, not interchangeable. Parcel ownership display is not a title search or easement determination.

sourceLinks.label: County parcel research layer — Michigan Tech mirror

records.reviewLimitations: Parcel mirror identifies the state GIS point as Iron River Assoc., LLC (03-113-001-00), and the alternate brochure point as Township of Carp Lake (03-113-002-30). Neither establishes title, visitor easement, rights over connecting property, trail access, or current road operation. Michigan DNR-managed-land point query returned no overlap, which does not prove ownership by itself.
records.nextEvidence: Reconcile actual official public lot and signed trail geometry against county parcels; verify legal visitor permission/easement and site management. Keep research-only and noindex.
